name: Seek Truth
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively seek truth through prayer and diligent pursuit, promising that those who ask, seek, and knock will find and receive answers (Matthew 7:7, 21:22). Jesus embodies truth, revealing God's grace and teaching with authority (John 1:14, 7:14). Knowing and embracing this truth brings spiritual freedom, setting believers free from error and false teachings (John 8:32; Mark 7:7).
